steps.what: Define the instructional class objectives and current crime-scene procedure sources
inputs: actual training request and learner needs
outputs: confirmed training brief and approved sources

steps.what: Coordinate available training times, room and equipment with participating officers
inputs: confirmed training brief and approved sources
existing officer availability and room/equipment calendars
outputs: confirmed training slot, resources and officer audience

steps.what: Prepare the training notice with the confirmed slot, instructions and recipients
inputs: confirmed training slot, resources and officer audience
outputs: complete training notice and recipient list

steps.what: Review and approve the final notice, timing and officer recipients
inputs: complete training notice and recipient list
outputs: approved final training notice and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved in-service training notice to the participating officers
inputs: approved final training notice and recipients

steps.what: Prepare instructional examples, demonstrations and exercises from approved procedures
inputs: confirmed training brief and approved sources

loop.purpose: Draft source-grounded training explanations and exercise wording
loop.input: confirmed objectives and approved procedure text
loop.output: proposed explanations and exercise instructions with source references
loop.check: Officer checks procedure meaning, sequence, omissions and the difference between illustrative examples and actual evidence; no unsupported procedure is accepted
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: Existing lesson material comes first; explaining a procedure for a new learner group requires semantic wording beyond field substitution

steps.what: Review the completed instructional material and confirm its fitness for delivery
inputs: confirmed training brief and approved sources

steps.what: Conduct the in-service class, demonstrate techniques and coach actual officer practice
outputs: delivered class and actual attendance/performance observations

steps.what: Enter actual attendance, observed exercise results and follow-up needs after training
inputs: delivered class and actual attendance/performance observations

steps.what: Check and approve the completed actual training record
Save the approved actual training record in the same learning system

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} availability and {EMAIL} templates for officer in-service coordination, with a separate approved notice send. Assist source-based instructional wording in {DOCS}, retain live demonstrations, and enter actual attendance and results in {LMS} only after delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Planned enrolment does not establish actual attendance or successful practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scheduling and templates can support coordination, while bounded drafting can propose training wording.
tasks.still_hard: Teach evidence-handling techniques and recognise incorrect practice.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstrate, observe and correct learner technique.

ambition.what: Support existing in-service training without claiming more classes or automatic certification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify approved-source access, staff records and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendars and learning systems support class coordination and actual attendance records; models can propose source-grounded teaching wording.

assumptions: Scenario is an internal officer in-service class, one of the statement's alternatives. Citizen classes require external-audience controls and corresponding send authority; no unpriced citizen delivery or extra output is assumed here. OTHER means the physical classroom and demonstration equipment.

Training requester supplies objectives and learner needs, procedure owner supplies approved source text, and existing calendars supply actual availability/resource constraints. s1 and s2 count validation and negotiation of missing/conflicting inputs. Native scheduling and existing lesson templates come first.

s3 assembles final date/location/instructions and officer recipients before s4 approval and s5 send. s6 creates finished material before s7 review and s8 teaching. s9 captures actual student ID, attendance, observed result and follow-up from s8; planned enrolment cannot fill those fields. s10 checks the finished record before s11 save; edits void approvals.

Central retains 75% of coordination, 50% of notice preparation and 80% of material preparation and removes only the real notice send. Live training and actual record entry remain unchanged. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving.
Provisional B=100, R=88, gross=12; incremental focal source/template upkeep=2; net=10. Shares are illustrative, not measured baselines or means priors.
unknowns: Existing lesson coverage, availability conflicts and actual preparation effort.
research_questions: Trace planning through actual post-class records and time all instructional corrections.

already_counted.description: Post-draft final instructional review in s7

incremental.description: Maintain approved instructional sources and inspect scheduling/template failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final training notice, timing and officer recipients
final record of actual attendance and exercise results

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where existing lessons and native coordination already suffice; high allows four additional hours of instructional correction and scheduling conflicts beyond central net 10.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check fingerprint image quality, provenance and case identifiers
inputs: actual fingerprint images and collection records
outputs: quality-checked fingerprint images and confirmed provenance

steps.what: Classify fingerprint patterns and record observed classification features
inputs: quality-checked fingerprint images and confirmed provenance

steps.what: Retrieve and read the fingerprint system's existing candidate results
inputs: quality-checked fingerprint images and confirmed provenance
outputs: available candidate prints and search context

steps.what: Compare fingerprint detail and assess similarities, differences and unresolved limitations
inputs: available candidate prints and search context

steps.what: Determine the supported fingerprint conclusion under the applicable examination protocol
Write and confirm the complete fingerprint classification, comparison findings and filing references
File the confirmed fingerprint examination record in the same fingerprint records system

tasks.design: Retain source checking, classification and comparison in {OTHER}, the authorised fingerprint examination and records system. Use its existing candidate search and native record form; no additional matching capability or automatic identification is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: A candidate result is not a supported fingerprint conclusion.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing fingerprint software assists search and filing but its runtime is already automated.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluate print quality, differences and evidential limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Make an accountable comparison grounded in actual images.

ambition.what: Preserve existing examination and filing controls.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fingerprint systems provide candidate results and examination records while examiners assess comparison findings.

assumptions: Existing collection officers supply actual image, item/case ID, source and collection time in ordinary evidence records. s1 checks these; missing provenance or unusable images require manual resolution. s2 and s6 explicitly capture actual classification and findings; no planned values or candidate ranking becomes an actual conclusion.

Boundary includes classification, search-result reading, comparison, conclusion, actual record writing and filing. Native search and record configuration are considered; automated search runtime is not focal human effort and earns no saving. No repeated hunting or re-keying baseline is established.

Existing required independent examination or sign-off must remain under the local protocol; no such work is claimed saved here. No new recognition model is proposed. s6 confirms the complete record before s7 filing; edits invalidate approval. Same-system filing is approximately zero time and earns no saving.
Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual local examination protocol and any distinct cross-system filing burden.
research_questions: Observe examination and record work separately from automated search runtime before proposing a workflow change.

incremental.description: No new workflow or upkeep introduced

approvals.approved_version: complete confirmed fingerprint examination record and filing references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction after separately examining source lookup, actual classification notes, comparison, final record writing and filing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview people and record actual accounts

steps.what: Read the authorised case material and determine the interview's scope and applicable procedure
inputs: current interview procedure and interviewee role
outputs: confirmed interview scope and source facts

steps.what: Prepare neutral interview questions for survivors, witnesses, suspects or law-enforcement personnel
inputs: confirmed interview scope and source facts
outputs: complete proposed question plan with source references

loop.purpose: Propose neutral questions that address the authorised scope
loop.input: permitted source facts, confirmed scope and approved question guidance
loop.output: draft questions and explicit unresolved factual gaps
loop.check: Officer checks neutrality, omissions, unsupported premises, procedure fit and distinction between known facts and allegations
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual question planning
loop.why_not_simpler: Approved question checklists come first; tailoring questions to case-specific free text requires semantic interpretation

steps.what: Review the completed question plan and determine what to ask
inputs: complete proposed question plan with source references
confirmed interview scope and source facts

steps.what: Conduct the interview, listen to the actual account and ask appropriate follow-up questions
outputs: actual interview account and observed limitations

steps.what: Capture the actual interview statements, source references and uncertainty
inputs: actual interview account and observed limitations

steps.what: Prepare the interview record without converting questions or allegations into facts
inputs: existing case identifiers and record requirements

steps.what: Read and approve the final interview record against the actual source account
Save the approved interview record in the same case system

tasks.design: Use approved guidance and permitted case sources in {DOCS} to propose a bounded question plan. The officer conducts the interview and writes the actual account in {OTHER}, the authorised interview and case-record system, before reviewing and separately saving its final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic question list may miss case-specific gaps or assume facts not established.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source-grounded drafting step can suggest questions for officer review.
tasks.still_hard: Listen carefully and follow the actual account without leading the interviewee.
tasks.human_edge: Build rapport and distinguish testimony, uncertainty and inference.

ambition.what: Support question preparation without automating interviews or credibility judgements.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6; verify permitted case processing, interview governance and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: language models can propose source-grounded interview questions for human review; live interviews still depend on the actual account.

assumptions: Existing case owner supplies permitted source text, case ID and provenance; s1 checks scope, interviewee role and applicable guidance. Missing facts remain question topics, never invented premises. Use only an authorised environment; absent permission, use the existing manual checklist and assign zero saving.

Question drafting is the only reduced step. Native approved checklists come first; central retains 60% of preparation plus all s3 final plan review. The interview, actual note capture, final record preparation and source checking remain unchanged. No report-drafting time saving is assumed.

OTHER means the authorised interview setting and case-record system. s5 counts actual account capture and s6 counts record composition. A question plan is not an interview account. No automated transcription, recording, credibility score or external message is introduced.

s7 approves the finished record before s8; edits invalidate approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; incremental focal approved-guidance upkeep=1; net=5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Permitted drafting environment and actual case-specific question-preparation effort.
research_questions: Review proposed question plans for neutrality and unsupported premises, including all correction time.

incremental.description: Maintain approved question guidance and inspect drafting failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final interview record grounded in the actual source account

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when the approved checklist already covers the plan or drafting access is unavailable; high allows two extra hours of question correction beyond central net 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
